author: NIN Creative Studio
title: NIN Creative Studio Hiring Illustrator Artists
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only. Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Call for Illustrators - Democracy Theme
content: Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, etc. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio. Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted.

author: Titmouse / Rachel Recruits
